$comment: MeanVC2 graphs for vc::families::meanvc (P5-C): Sigil's export of ASLP-lab/MeanVC2@13acf84c (40 ms model; HF ASLP-lab/MeanVC2 @39cdd195 meanvc2_40ms_40ms.safetensors, fastu2pp_80ms.pt, vocos.pt) by scripts/vc-families/meanvc/export.py (fbank, asr, gtm, dit_step, vocos; sha256 as measured in scripts/vc-families/reports/meanvc_cpu.json). Starts unpublished (install with the Models tab's Import or SIGIL_LOCAL_ASSETS=<the export folder>) and becomes 'published' with scripts/models/publish-entries.mjs --write once the files are on the assets-v1 release.

vc/meanvc2-speaker is the speaker encoder (WavLM-Large + the fine-tuned ECAPA-TDNN of upstream runtime/src/speaker.py) as one model.onnx: input the 16 kHz mono reference clip [1, N] in -1..1, first output the raw 256-value embedding. Its fine-tuned weights (wavlm_large_finetune.pth) are a manual Google Drive download, so the entry is import-only and unpinned until a maintainer exports it. A voice folder's speaker.npy (upstream preprocess/extract_spk_emb.py) works without it.

entries.title: MeanVC2 voice graphs
entries.description: Zero-shot voice conversion on the CPU (MeanVC2, experimental): the content encoder, the DiT and the vocoder. About 182 MB.

entries.title: MeanVC2 speaker encoder
entries.description: Analyses a reference voice for MeanVC2 voices (WavLM-Large + ECAPA-TDNN). Import a model.onnx exported from the fine-tuned weights. About 1.2 GB.
